reasoning: Bitset transitive closure determines the maximum relation after removing reflexive pairs. Vertices with identical reflexive reachability rows are exactly the strongly connected components. Each nontrivial component can be represented by a directed cycle of its size. Between components, the condensation DAG has a unique transitive reduction; process each outgoing neighbor in decreasing reachable-set size, retaining an edge only when its target is not already covered by a previously retained successor. This counts the required cover edges without requiring the new edges to occur in the original graph.
